verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud's docs say data sources are segregated so users can update, delete, or add data independently, which documents user-controlled deletion. The on-prem option lets data live on the customer's own infrastructure, though that concerns deployment location rather than retention control. Nothing describes retention periods, automatic expiry/TTL, purge guarantees, or how deletion propagates to embeddings, backups, or AI answer logs. Missing for 10: retention policy configuration, TTL/auto-expiry, documented deletion guarantees for derived embeddings and backups, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Every data source is segregated from the others, so you can update, delete, or add new data without affecting the data in the other data sources.
We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.
